exposure: Cesarean section at full dilatation (CSfd) in the first birth
outcome: Miscarriage in the second pregnancy (any gestation)
cohort: Women who had a first-term birth and a subsequent second birth recorded within the Aberdeen Maternity and Neonatal Databank.
finding: There was no association between a first-term cesarean section at full dilatation and an increased risk of miscarriage in the next pregnancy.
mod_finding: Women who had a first cesarean section at full dilatation were no more likely to have a miscarriage at any gestation than women with all other modes of first birth.
gest_age: First-term births (>=37 weeks); Miscarriage prior to 24 weeks gestation; Early miscarriage (<13 weeks); Late miscarriage (13-23 + 6 weeks).
